name: Kinuo
source:
A geisha who is currently staying at [url=/c47229]Tsuguno's[/url] inn.
She doesn't talk much, but her elegant movements attract men all the same.
She's popular among the Choushuu loyalists so she uses the nickname of the 'loyalist geisha' but she isn't very interested in the ideology herself.
She sometimes comes to [url=/c47200]Iori's[/url] room, but she doesn't talk, she just sits there quietly playing the shamisen.
